rationale: The signal explicitly excludes evidence about other scores, drafting, contacts and intent. Agreement between copies of one examined score therefore supports the stated evidential boundary and cannot certify every stage of the award.

signal_basis.exact_text: Both authenticated independent copies contain the same examined score, and neither contains an intervening alteration.
No other scores, drafting records, contact records or intent evidence is supplied.
The stated independence and authentication hold for this score entry.
